content.name: Temple of Aminishi
content.detail: ED1 on Aminishi (Sanctum Guardian, Masuta the Ascended, Seiryu). Equilibrium lists under Asgarnia combat via Arc mapping; access from Port Sarim / Quartermaster Gully after Impressing the Locals. Dungeoneering XP/tokens plus rare drops (Masuta's warspear, ancient scales, etc.).

ops.reason: Equilibrium League Asgarnia notable combat activities — Void Knights boat from Port Sarim.

content.name: Pest Control
content.detail: Safe co-op minigame at the Void Knights' Outpost. Free boat from the Port Sarim pier (Squire). Commendations buy Void Knight equipment; Conquest shares the outpost logistics. Combat level landers: 35 / 70 / 100.

ops.reason: Equilibrium League Asgarnia notable combat activities — Burthorpe defenders / tokens hub.

content.name: Warriors' Guild
content.detail: West Burthorpe guild (Attack+Strength 130 combined, or 99 in either). Activity tokens buy cyclops enclosure time for defenders through dragon. Combat bracelet teleports to the door; games necklace lands at Troll Invasion just north.

ops.reason: Equilibrium League Asgarnia notable combat activities — monthly Burthorpe D&D.

content.name: Troll Invasion
content.detail: Monthly safe D&D at the gatehouse north of the Warriors' Guild (Captain Jute). Combat waves or repair/skilling mode; first completion each month yields a reward book. Games necklace teleport; counts toward troll Slayer kills in fight mode.

ops.reason: Equilibrium League Asgarnia notable combat activities — classic midgame dungeon under Taverley.

content.name: Taverley Dungeon
content.detail: Large members dungeon south of Taverley: chaos druids, Black Knights' Base, blue dragons + scales, hellhounds, black demons/dragons, fire/water obelisks. Dusty key (or Agility shortcuts 70/80) for deep routes; hellhound and blue dragon resource dungeons branch off.
